description: This record groups national water infrastructure layers on the Humanitarian Data Exchange that are not covered by a global inventory: Cambodia's dams and canals from the Department of Geography of the Ministry of Land Management (2008) and well locations from the Ministry of Rural Development (2009); Sri Lanka's tanks and reservoirs at 1:250,000 from the Survey Department; Myanmar's sluice gates (a non-authoritative list of more than 300 water control structures, 274 with coordinates, 2025) and lakes and dams extracted from Landsat, Sentinel-1 and Google imagery (2022) by the Myanmar Information Management Unit; dam positions in Mozambique's watersheds adjusted by UNDAC after Cyclone Idai (2019); and dam and wastewater treatment plant locations in eastern Libya compiled by UNDAC after the September 2023 Derna flood. The producers are those agencies; OCHA offices, MIMU and UNDAC published them. Coverage is national for Cambodia, Sri Lanka and Myanmar and regional for Mozambique's watersheds and eastern Libya. All are a free download from HDX as shapefile or GeoJSON, under CC BY, CC0 or HDX's "Other" licence. Caveats: the layers carry few attributes (names and locations), several are old, and MIMU states its layers are not authoritative. Simulation uses: locating dams, canals, sluice gates and treatment plants for flood exposure and emergency response. Related records: the Global Dam Watch database (data-global-dam-watch-database) and HydroWASTE (data-hydrowaste).
